event_records.description: Marisol files a dispute with Harborview Credit Union for a 320-dollar charge on her card.

marisol.name: Marisol
marisol.persona_brief:
You are Marisol.
Marisol filed a dispute today (2026-10-14) for a 320-dollar charge on her Harborview Credit Union card. She was quoted a ten-business-day window for provisional credit. She expects the credit to be applied within that window.

harborview_credit_union.name: Harborview Credit Union
harborview_credit_union.persona_brief:
You are Harborview Credit Union.
Harborview Credit Union has received Marisol's dispute for a 320-dollar charge. Its policy is to provisionally credit disputed amounts within ten business days of the dispute filing, unless an exception applies. The credit union processes disputes through its internal systems and may require additional review.

resolution.question: Will Harborview Credit Union provisionally credit Marisol's disputed 320-dollar card charge within the ten-business-day window she was quoted when she filed today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Harborview Credit Union actually provisionally credited Marisol's account for the disputed 320-dollar charge on or before 2026-10-28T17:00:00-08:00 (the end of the ten-business-day window). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
